authority.source_of_truth: Content-addressed released experiment packages, manifests, receipts, and immutable publication history.
authority.task_authority: Reviewed archival and publication issues referencing exact Compiler package identities.
authority.acceptance_authority: Clean verification of manifest closure, replay evidence, exact source and artifact hashes, and human publication approval.
authority.deployment_authority: GitHub release and Zenodo publication identities protected separately from scientific acceptance.

data.retention: Released packages, manifests, receipts, and DOI-linked metadata are retained immutably.
data.deletion: Withdrawn or defective releases are marked superseded or retracted; published history is not silently rewritten.
data.secret_storage: Publication tokens and repository credentials remain in protected environments outside artifacts.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Publication candidates can be revoked before release; released packages use explicit retraction and supersession records.

stabilization.summary: Rebuild and verify release packages from exact source in a clean independent environment.
Attach provenance attestations to release packages and verify them before publication.
Publish compact rights, privacy, decontamination, and permitted-use metadata for every corpus or model-derived artifact.
